observations: TO ROBIN, requirement conflict: on the catalogue 80 x 60 perfboard the first grid column is X 5.71 (grid_margin_x 4.74). A Pico whose header pins lie on the grid (L3.1.6.1) has USB_MOUTH X >= 5.71 - 1.37 - 1.3 = 3.04. That is outside V1's delta range [-1.8, 0.5] for L3.1.3.1. So L3.1.3.1 (weight 2) and L3.1.6.1 (weight 1) cannot both pass, and no V1 design can MEET as written. CORRECT is still reachable, and this design is CORRECT. I graded the delta as written. Either widen the USB mouth range (for example to [-1.8, 3.6], as in E1-01's 'first pin on grid column 0') or exempt the Pico from the grid rule in V1.
Tight but passing: the lid lip underside (Z 12.1) clears V-KO-TOP by only 0.10, and the floor top (Z -5.7) clears V-KO-BOT by only 0.10.

The lid lip is notched at all four corners (cylinder Ø7.11 around each boss axis, Z 11.1-14.2) to clear the corner bosses. The corner bosses (Ø6.6 at (-3.29,-3.29) etc.) intrude 0.21 mm into the cavity corners. The lip stays continuous (one ring in the Z 13 section), with a minimum local thickness of about 1.05, and the notch-to-boss gap is 0.25. That is acceptable under L2.7.5 but worth noting.
The design's own self-report has no check for port-mouth position, so the agent did not see the L3.1.3.1 limit.
